chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The world will not pass away until a man from the progeny of Al-Husayn rises and fills it with justice, just as it was filled with oppression and tyranny.'
ai.seo_question: Who will fill the world with justice according to the Prophet's prophecy?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, articulates the core Shia eschatological belief in the Mahdi, identifying him as the specific descendant of Al-Husayn (AS) who will fill the earth with justice. It underscores the theological concept of divine retribution and restoration, where the Ahl al-Bayt serve as the instruments of cosmic balance, transforming a world saturated with tyranny into one of equity. This narration is frequently cited to validate the authority of the Imams and the ultimate triumph of truth over falsehood in Islamic history.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-294 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
the Prophet (S) said, “The world will not end until one from the progeny of Al-Husayn (a.s.) rises and spreads justice all over the world which oppression and force have covered up with darkness.”
